subject: Using Google Analytics on my Shiny apps

messages.author: e27f916765f79080
messages.subject: Using Google Analytics on my Shiny apps
parts:
Hi,

I started using Shiny recently, hosted at spark, and I'm superexcited about it! So I also wanted to track the usage of the apps, and searched for instructions about how to include Google Analytics into my apps.
I found this: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/UTdnc19gbp4,
and followed the example in this app: https://github.com/trestletech/shiny-sandbox/blob/master/grn/ui.R#L7

However, GA does not recognize it. Looking at the source code for my app (http://spark.rstudio.com/ouzor/Sotkanet/), I notice that there already is a GA script by someone else, with the account UA-20375833-4. Is this something used by RStudio, or what is going on?

So can anyone help me to use GA properly with Shiny apps hosted at spark?

br, Juuso

messages.author: e27f916765f79080
messages.subject: Re: Using Google Analytics on my Shiny apps
parts:
Hi again,

GA actually seems to now have started tracking, so it just takes some time to get working.

Anyway can anyone tell what the other GA tracker is and whose is it?

br, Juuso
